about: D22 FINAL: post-processed response bodies of the GRADER-CORE-1 PR-2 ACCEPTANCE run (2026-10-05.PR2-accept-a-flash38, run 1), replayed through the shipped post-processing with zero model calls. legacy/ = the request as the surface sends it; v2/ = acceptsV2:true (the run's own V2.* reply where one exists, else the same stored reply — acceptsV2 never reaches the prompt).
